subject: Request: Special pilot incentive and POC extension for CardinalAI
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Special pilot incentive and POC extension for CardinalAI

Team — quick context and ask.

CardinalAI (Ellen Park, procurement@cardinalai.com) has been running our hosted trial for the last 3 weeks on a regulated dataset. They’ve been impressed with inference latency, but need more runway and a slightly larger credit bucket to complete an internal security and product validation (NLP model parity tests + performance at 10k qps sim).

What they’re requesting:
- 90‑day POC extension (current PLG limit: 30 days)
- $50,000 in free credits up front to run scale tests and integration work (this exceeds our standard trial cap)
- Confirmation on audit log retention (they need 1 year) and an NDA addendum to reflect their compliance needs

Attachments: draft SOW and their completed security questionnaire (see attachments list).

Why I’m asking for exec signoff: the size and regulatory needs are larger than a typical PLG lead — CardinalAI is a strategic prospect (aiming to embed inference in a regulated clinical workflow). If we nail this, near‑term ARR opportunity is material and they’re prepared to commit to a paid pilot after validation.

Proposed fallback if full ask is denied:
- Offer 60‑day extension + $30k credits and get a signed LOA/PO for validation work.

Requested approvals / next steps:
1) Exec approval for extension + credits OR approval to offer the fallback above.
2) Legal / Finance to review addendum language and approve 1‑year audit log retention (or state constraints).
3) If approved, I’ll send an LOA and escalation to Finance to tag the account for trial gating.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read. This is time sensitive; they want confirmation by end of week.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555‑0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Special pilot incentive and POC extension for CardinalAI

Karthik — thanks for the writeup and attachments. Quick notes from Deal Desk / Sales Ops: 

- Anything > $25k in complimentary credits and extensions beyond 45 days require exec signoff (Aditya/CRO or CEO) per our deal desk policy.
- We need a concise one‑page Deal Desk Brief (I started a template in the HubSpot deal — link below) with: expected ARR, conversion likelihood, procurement timeline, and confirmation of who will sign the LOA/PO.
- Finance needs the SOW to indicate that credits are one‑time and will not be refundable; also need to know whether they want metered overage alerts.

I’m escalating and marking as high priority — Aditya, tagging for your review. If you prefer, we can offer the fallback Karthik suggested (60 days + $30k) as a negotiated concession to secure the PO.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

—
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cardinalai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cardinalai.com
Date: 2028-05-21T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Special pilot incentive and POC extension for CardinalAI

Thanks Karthik / Marissa — appreciate the quick coordination. A few clarifying points from CardinalAI’s side: 

- We can get LOA/PO signed quickly once we have the extension and credit commitment in writing. Procurement prefers a 60‑90 day window; 90 would be ideal but 60 is workable if credits are sufficient.
- Security: 1 year audit log retention is preferred; if that’s not feasible we need explicit documentation on retention limits and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM.
- We’re prepared to accept a one‑time credit allocation that clearly states non‑transferable and for evaluation only. We’ll also sign a short addendum for data handling.

I’ve attached a redacted procurement checklist and the internal approver list (not attached here due to size) — procurement@cardinalai.com will handle the PO.

If it helps, we can accept the fallback (60 days + $30k) if that expedites approval on your side. Please let us know by COB Friday.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Integrations | CardinalAI
ellen.park@cardinalai.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-21T18:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Special pilot incentive and POC extension for CardinalAI

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed. High level decision and conditions below.

Approval (one‑time, limited):
- Approved: $30,000 in complimentary credits (one‑time allocation)
- Approved: 60‑day POC extension from the date the LOA is signed

Conditions / caveats:
1) Credits are non‑recurring and tied to the CardinalAI HubSpot deal (CARD-2028-042). No additional complimentary credits beyond this approval.
2) CardinalAI must execute a short addendum covering data handling and 1‑year audit log export capability OR confirm export to their SIEM. Legal to draft; Marissa to attach to LOA.
3) Procurement must issue a PO or signed LOA prior to credits being applied. Finance (cc’d Laura) to gate the account and enable the credit allocation only after PO is received.
4) If production usage is observed prior to a paid contract, the account will be moved to a paid tier and standard pricing will apply.

Marissa / Finance / Legal — please action the gating and addendum. Karthik — share the final LOA and we’ll log the approver and timeline in the deal.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
